title: Zentra Systems opens Kharadi campus
text: Zentra Systems, a software firm, will open a new 2,000-seat campus in Kharadi, Pune, in March 2026. The campus will include a 600-seat cafeteria operated by FreshPlate Catering.

title: Tender notice
text: Tender notice: Pune Institute of Applied Sciences invites bids for cafeteria housekeeping and dish-washing services for its hostel mess, closing 15 April 2026.

title: Facilities Manager
text: Northwind GCC Pune is hiring a Facilities Manager for its Hinjewadi office. Posted 2 March 2026. Zentra Systems Pvt Ltd is a partner.
